# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.65

- **Exporting again is faster:** the words read by OCR from a page are remembered in memory (the last 64 pages) under the exact pixels of the page and the OCR options. If you export again after changing only what does not touch the pixels (JPEG quality, PDF options, size target when it does not resize the page), the slowest step, OCR, is skipped for those pages. A page whose pixels changed is read again. Measured on a 4096×3072 photo: the second reading of the same page costs about nothing instead of about 2.6 s.
- Where the time goes (profile of one phone photo, with OCR): OCR 75 %, clean-up 19 %, loading 4 %. Tesseract runs on the processor, so a graphics card would not shorten it.
